_readme: THE config file for the Ladies of Destiny agent. pageId/pageName/igUserId/igUsername/pageAccessToken are AUTO-FILLED the first time a valid token is provided (paste a fresh Graph API Explorer token into data/meta-token.txt and push, or run the workflow once). To change posting time: edit 'slots' (EAT). To pause: set autoPost=false. IG catch-up window after slot time: graceMinutes (90 = IG retries until 1.5h past the slot, then that day's IG is skipped; use the force button to rescue it manually).
